time_convention: t = frame / fps; frame 0 at t = 0
units: pixels (full 2160x3840 resolution, x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed
description: Top-down/frontal view of a pink wall lit by a round spotlight. A hand holding a red/pink 'CREDIT CARD' (chip, '0000 0000 0000 0000') sweeps it in from the bottom-right dark corner, up-left into the spotlight, decelerating to rest near the spot's centre. Camera static.

camera.evidence: half-max bounding box of the spotlight disc constant to within one 4-px sample over all 39 frames (x 100-2040, y 1092-3008); centroid shifts only 10-25 px when the hand/arm occlusion enters (scene/tracks/spotlight.csv)

objects.name: card
objects.aka: credit card, red card, pink card
objects.identify: the only saturated red/pink rectangle; text 'CREDIT CARD', gold chip on its left, 16 zeros; held at its right end between thumb and fingers
objects.visible_frames: 0-38 (frames 0-7 dark and motion blurred in the vignetted corner; clear from frame 8)
objects.reference_point: visible centre (mask centroid frames 8-38; by-eye centre frames 0-7)

pixel_size_at_rest_frames_33_38.note: long axis nearly horizontal (tilt ~1-2 deg). Length = left edge (x~929) to right edge (x~1362), right end partly under the thumb but its corners are visible. Card is held at an angle so aspect 1.44 (not ISO 1.586).

objects.apparent_length_vs_time: grows from ~380 px (frames 8-13) to ~412 (frames 14-23) to ~432 (frames 30-38): card was tilted/nearer camera early and/or motion blur; prefer the rest value 432 px for a scale

objects.name: hand
objects.aka: hand and forearm holding the card
objects.identify: skin-coloured hand entering from the right/bottom-right, thumb on top of the card's right end
objects.track: moves rigidly with the card (use tracks/card.csv); not separately tracked
objects.pixel_size_frame_38: hand from card's right end (x~1340) to wrist ~x1900; forearm leaves frame at right edge around y 2700-3300

objects.name: card_shadow
objects.identify: dark rectangle on the wall offset to the left of the card
objects.note: frame 38: shadow left edge x~824, i.e. ~105 px left of the card's left edge; same height as the card; moves with the card. Excluded from the card mask.

objects.name: spotlight
objects.aka: circle of light, lit disc on the wall
objects.note: soft edge: diameter depends on threshold (half of 1st-99th percentile grey level)

events.event: card already moving at frame 0 (motion starts before the clip)
card enters the bright spotlight area
card centre passes into the disc interior; per-frame step falls below 50 px
card comes essentially to rest (step < 7 px/frame from frame 32, <5 px from frame 36)
end of clip, card held still near spot centre at (1135, 2058)

motion_summary_px.direction: up-left, monotonic deceleration, no reversal; path slightly curved (steeper at start)
motion_summary_px.per_frame_step_px: see step_px column of tracks/card.csv (~100-135 px/frame frames 1-8, ~60 at 11-14, ~25 at 20-23, ~12 at 28-31, <7 after 32)
